description: This file defines the ConnectorFactory class, responsible for managing connector source instances, loading source classes, and including relevant PHP files within a SuiteCRM context.

classes.name: ConnectorFactory
classes.description: A factory class providing methods to instantiate and load connector source components, and to include connector class files based on naming conventions.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves or creates and caches a connector source component based on the source name.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a class and its dependencies for a given class name and type.

methods.name: loadClass
methods.description: Includes the PHP file for a specified class, searching through potential directory paths.
